I've answered Tobias in our DM: he should keep Tuesday, Nov 10 at 12:15 free for the Gannet call.

That time comes from what he told me in our DM on Oct 14. He said his standing Gannet rollout call with the Tansleigh Packaging team had moved to Tuesdays at 12:15. The call isn't on his calendar for Nov 9–13, so I suggested he add a hold. I couldn't find how long the call runs, so I told him to block his usual length.

I didn't change his calendar or share the time with anyone else.
